notes.title: 波的能流、能流密度、能量密度
notes.description: 三个量的区别：总功率、单位面积功率、单位体积能量。

definitions.meaning: 单位时间内通过某个截面的平均能量，也就是平均功率。
单位时间、单位面积通过的平均能量，也叫平均强度。
单位体积内平均储存的波动能量。

body: 通过截面的平均能流，也就是平均功率，表示单位时间内穿过某个截面的能量。记作 \(\overline{P}\)，单位是 W。
波的平均能流密度，也叫平均强度，表示单位时间、单位面积通过的能量。记作 \(\overline{I}\)，单位是 \(\mathrm{W/m^2}\)。
波的平均能量密度表示单位体积内平均储存的波动能量。记作 \(\overline{w}\)，单位是 \(\mathrm{J/m^3}\)。
直观理解：1 秒内穿过单位面积的那段波，长度是波速 \(v\)，所以体积是 \(v \times 1\)。里面的平均能量就是 \(\overline{w}v\)，因此 \(\overline{I}=\overline{w}v\)。
如果波垂直穿过面积 \(S\)，那么通过截面的平均能流 \(\overline{P}=\overline{I}S=\overline{w}vS\)。如果传播方向和截面法线夹角为 \(\theta\)，则 \(\overline{P}=\overline{I}S\cos\theta\)。
notes.formula: P_bar = ΔE/Δt; I_bar = P_bar/S; w_bar = ΔE/ΔV; I_bar = w_bar v; P_bar = I_bar S

notes.title: 驻波实验：4 个波腹时的张力
notes.description: 弦长 3 m，频率 60 Hz，弦质量 20 g；弦上有 4 个波腹，求施加张力。
body: 有 4 个波腹，说明弦长等于 4 段半波长。默认两端固定，所以两端是波节。
先由波腹个数求波长，再由频率求波速，最后用弦波公式求张力。
弦质量为 20 g，也就是 0.020 kg；弦长为 3 m，所以线密度为质量除以弦长。
因此需要的张力是 54 N。

notes.title: Green's theorem
notes.description: A planar circulation theorem: turn a boundary integral into an area integral over the enclosed region.
body: For a positively oriented, simple closed curve C bounding a region D, Green's theorem connects local curl in the plane with circulation around the boundary.
A useful reading: if the right-hand side is large, the vector field has accumulated microscopic rotation across the whole region.

notes.title: Gauss's theorem
notes.description: Also called the divergence theorem: flux through a closed surface equals total divergence inside.
body: For a solid region V with boundary surface S and outward normal n, the theorem translates surface flux into a volume integral.
It is the right tool when a field's source or sink density is easier to understand than its behavior on every point of the boundary.

notes.title: Stokes' theorem
notes.description: The surface version of curl: circulation around a boundary equals curl flux through any spanning surface.
body: For an oriented surface S with boundary curve ∂S, Stokes' theorem says that the line integral around the edge measures the total curl passing through the surface.
Green's theorem appears as a flat, two-dimensional special case of this statement.
